about: The inputs behind the S-H arm (Arm D) and the bromine arm (Arm C-Br) of benchmarks/restart_v3/PREREGISTRATION.md, as the papers print them, so tests/test_restart_v3_references.py can recompute every derived number instead of restating it. Nothing here has been computed by the application. Written 2026-10-27.

constants.d0_to_d298_ethanethiol_source: ervin2015: D0(C2H5S-H) = 359.5 kJ/mol and D298 = 364.7 kJ/mol with thermal enthalpy corrections computed there for the ethyl radical only
constants.borrowed_thermal_note: Used only for the excluded tert-butanethiol bond: Ervin 2015's ethyl step of +5.2 kJ/mol, with 1.0 kJ/mol added in quadrature for borrowing it. The two propanethiols of Arm D use a step computed in thermal_step.py instead.
constants.thermal_step_uncertainty_rule: the larger of 0.5 kJ/mol and the spread of the step over the usable parent/radical conformer pairs

methanethiol_anchor.note: The D0(CH3S-H) that every Arm D reference leans on, and a third measurement that Ervin 2015 did not use. Read 2026-10-28 in the PDFs (wu2025 and ervin2015). Recomputed by tests/test_restart_v3_references.py.
methanethiol_anchor.ervin2015_routes: two, combined: the Br + CH3SH kinetics of nicovich1992 (359.7 +- 2.8 kJ/mol) and a photofragment route through D0(CH3-S) = 3.045 +- 0.015 eV with enthalpies of formation (359.7 +- 1.7 kJ/mol)
methanethiol_anchor.wilson1994_source: H-atom photofragment translational spectroscopy of CH3SH, S. H. S. Wilson, M. N. R. Ashfold and R. N. Dixon, J. Chem. Phys. 101, 7538 (1994), reference 33 of wu2025 (which quotes it twice as 'D0(H3CS-H) = 30 250 +- 100 cm-1'). READ 2026-10-28 (wilson1994): D0 = 30 250 +- 100 cm-1 is the dissociation threshold for forming the lower 2E3/2 spin-orbit state of CH3S(X), from a line-shape simulation of the resolved v = 0 spin-orbit doublet in the 274.0 nm H-atom spectrum (50 cm-1 resolution), cross-checked against the vibronic structure of the CH3S A-X dispersed emission. The authors themselves call it 'in good agreement with the most recent literature value (85.96 +- 0.68 kcal/mol, 30 065 +- 240 cm-1)', which is Nicovich 1992.
methanethiol_anchor.sensitivity_note: An upper bound on how far the three Arm D references could move: the thiols' acidities are measured relative to CH3SH, so a shift of the anchor passes into them at most one for one; the least-squares network with H2S and pyrrole passes less. Not a correction.

thiophenol_context.note: Thiophenol is NOT in Arm D. Its two newest 0 K determinations disagree by 3.3 kcal/mol, and the one that is explicitly an upper limit lies above the other. Read 2026-10-28.
thiophenol_context.devine2008_kind: UPPER LIMIT: the authors say so (the peak is assigned to H + C6H5S(X, v = 0), but the possibility that all of the products carry an additional unrecognized quantum of vibration cannot be excluded). H(D) Rydberg-atom photofragment translational spectroscopy, 290.00 nm and neighbouring wavelengths, mean parent internal energy about 100 cm-1 assumed.

sh_bonds.name: ethanethiol S-H
sh_bonds.electron_affinity_source: moran1988 (the value Ervin used); janousek1980 gives 1.953 +- 0.006
sh_bonds.thermal_step_check: the method of thermal_step.py applied to ethanethiol, held to Ervin 2015's published D298 - D0 = 5.2 kJ/mol by tests/test_restart_v3_references.py

sh_bonds.name: 1-propanethiol S-H
sh_bonds.d298_status: DERIVED here from the two printed inputs plus a thermal step COMPUTED here (thermal_step.py); not a published number
sh_bonds.thermal_step_source: computed by benchmarks/restart_v3/thermal_step.py (B3LYP/def2-TZVPD harmonic frequencies of the lowest-enthalpy usable conformers; records in benchmarks/restart_v3/artifacts/thermal_step/): the radical's and the hydrogen atom's thermal enthalpies minus the parent's, zero-point energy excluded. A property of the reference, not of the calculation under test.

sh_context.note: Not part of Arm D. Methanethiol's S-H is the first run's lost bond (spent): nicovich1992 Table IX gives 87.35 +- 0.58 kcal/mol at 298 K (85.96 +- 0.68 at 0 K, 2 sigma), ervin2015 uses D0 = 359.7 +- 1.5 kJ/mol as an anchor of the same acidity network, so every Arm D reference shares that anchor with it. Thiophenol is NOT in the arm: borgesdossantos2002 gives 349.4 +- 4.5 kJ/mol (83.5 +- 1.1 kcal/mol, gas phase derived from solution calorimetry) and lim2007 gives D0 = 76.8 +- 0.3 kcal/mol at 0 K; they disagree by about 5 kcal/mol and neither is a 1.0 kcal/mol reference.

other_determinations_kj.method: FT-ICR review, key 2000BOR/ING (Luo Table 3.5; no uncertainty printed)

bromine_excluded.name: tribromomethane C-H
bromine_excluded.reason: no reference passes the 1.0 kcal/mol rule: Luo Table 3.5 gives 401.7 +- 6.7 kJ/mol (96.0 +- 1.6 kcal/mol) and 399.2 +- 8.4; seetula2000's CBr3 formation enthalpy is an ab initio estimate with +-5 kJ/mol; andress2026 calculates 392.4 (FPD) with no uncertainty.
